The positions are purely contractual, for a period of one year only, and are currently open for locations in Madhya Pradesh. The last date to apply is 12-09-2026. Register for Job Alerts

qualification.education_qualification: 12th (Intermediate/Senior Secondary) OR Matriculation + 2 Years ITI OR Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma

selection_process: A detailed selection process is not specified in the provided notification. However
the notification indicates that candidates need to clear the Aadhaar Supervisor exam and
complete Aadhaar LMS Certification as part of the certification requirement (see Important Instructions below).
how_to_apply: The specific online application process and application link are not specified in the provided notification. The notification does provide the following related process for exam and certification:
Candidates can take the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the link: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action

When a candidate applies for the exam, an authorization request is sent to the State Team. Once the State Team approves the request, the candidate will be able to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
Candidates can take the Aadhaar LMS Certification once their LMS ID and Password are created and approved, through the link: https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in
important_instructions: Applications are invited purely on a contract basis for a period of 1 (one) year only. Candidates must have an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar service. The Aadhaar Supervisor exam requires prior authorization approval from the State Team before a candidate can appear. Aadhaar LMS Certification can be taken only after the LMS ID and Password are created and approved. VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) are not eligible to apply for this position.

content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies have been announced for the Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator - District post, across two districts of Madhya Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator - District post must meet the following educational qualification and certification requirements. Candidates should note that holding the minimum educational qualification alone does not make a candidate eligible; the Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate authorized by UIDAI is a mandatory requirement as per the notification.

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Selection Process
content_sections.text: A detailed selection process is not specified in the provided notification. However, the notification indicates that candidates need to clear the Aadhaar Supervisor exam and, where applicable, complete Aadhaar LMS Certification as part of the certification requirement (see Important Instructions below).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The specific online application process and application link are not specified in the provided notification. The notification does provide the following related process for exam and certification: Candidates can take the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the link: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action When a candidate applies for the exam, an authorization request is sent to the State Team. Once the State Team approves the request, the candidate will be able to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam. Candidates can take the Aadhaar LMS Certification once their LMS ID and Password are created and approved, through the link: https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are invited purely on a contract basis for a period of 1 (one) year only. Candidates must have an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar service. The Aadhaar Supervisor exam requires prior authorization approval from the State Team before a candidate can appear. Aadhaar LMS Certification can be taken only after the LMS ID and Password are created and approved. VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) are not eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK) under CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd to fill the post of Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District on a contract basis for 1 year, currently in Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available: 3 in Bhind and 1 in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 12-09-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates need 12th pass, or Matriculation with 2 years ITI, or Matriculation with 3 years Polytechnic Diploma, along with a UIDAI-authorized Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate and basic computer skills.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The upper age limit is not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: The exact application link and process are not specified in the provided notification. Candidates take the Aadhaar Supervisor exam via the official exam login link after State Team authorization, and complete LMS Certification via the official UIDAI e-learning link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: Remuneration is set as per the minimum wages of the respective state for semi-skilled manpower. An exact salary figure is not specified in the provided notification.
